fusions.name: Parted Lash
fusions.desc: Splits one arm in two, loosing 2 bolts spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Barbed Branch
fusions.desc: A forked arm tip stabs the target for 14 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Back the Other Way
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Spare Prong
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a spare arm lashes the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
